cohort: 611 mothers who gave birth at health institutions in the South Gondar zone, northwest Ethiopia
finding: Only 39.4% of women reported receiving respectful maternity care, with completed secondary education, having antenatal care follow-up, planned pregnancy, cesarean section delivery, and daytime delivery being significantly associated with higher odds of receiving respectful care.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was significantly associated with receiving respectful maternity care.
